0022600143.text: The Lakers (3-1) come into this game on a one-game losing streak, sitting 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West, with a 2-1 home record and a 1-0 road mark. The LA Clippers (1-2) are on a two-game losing streak, 1.5 games back in 3rd in the Pacific and 9th in the West, and the Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 125-117 win in Los Angeles on 2026-10-23, while the 2025-26 series was split 2-2. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back) and Ziaire Williams (foot), and the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis in the foot), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery).
